dedupe_keys.name: melbourne street lights with emitted lux level council owned lights

description: The City of Melbourne publishes the light output, in lux, of the street lights it owns, with each light's location and the brightness stored in a label field. The Data Vic page says it was published on 7 March 2023 and last modified on 13 June 2024, and that the data can be seen in Digital Twin Victoria and reached through an API. Files are offered as CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, KML, Shapefile and Excel, free of charge under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Coverage is the municipality of Melbourne at asset level and no update frequency is stated. Caveats: only council-owned lights are included, so lights owned by other bodies are missing, the values are design or modelled emitted levels, not measured street illuminance, and the file is more than two years since its last change. It suits capacity planning and energy studies of public lighting, safety analysis of public space and city digital twins. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
